---
title: "Do penguin species differ in flipper length?"
author: "Dr. Ariel Cintrón-Arias (example)"
format:
  html:
    toc: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| code-summary: "Code: read the data and compute the numbers"
library(tidyverse)

penguins <- read_csv("../data/example/penguins.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Mean flipper length per species (2 penguins have no measurement)
flipper_means <- penguins %>%
  filter(!is.na(flipper_length_mm)) %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(mean_mm = mean(flipper_length_mm))

mean_of <- function(sp) flipper_means %>% filter(species == sp) %>% pull(mean_mm)
gentoo_vs_chinstrap_mm <- mean_of("Gentoo") - mean_of("Chinstrap")
gentoo_vs_adelie_mm <- mean_of("Gentoo") - mean_of("Adelie")

n_penguins <- nrow(penguins)
n_islands <- n_distinct(penguins$island)
n_no_flipper <- sum(is.na(penguins$flipper_length_mm))
first_year <- min(penguins$year)
last_year <- max(penguins$year)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-flippers
#| code-summary: "Code: make the figure"
#| fig-cap: "Flipper length by species. Each point is one penguin; each box shows the middle half of a species, and the line inside it is the median."
#| fig-alt: "Box plots with one point per penguin, showing flipper length in millimeters for Adelie, Chinstrap and Gentoo penguins. Gentoo flippers are clearly the longest; Chinstrap flippers are slightly longer than Adelie flippers."
set.seed(3901)  # same jitter on every render
penguins %>%
  filter(!is.na(flipper_length_mm)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = species, y = flipper_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(end = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Gentoo penguins have the longest flippers",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Flipper length (mm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

**Finding.** Gentoo penguins have the longest flippers, on average about `r round(gentoo_vs_chinstrap_mm)` mm longer than Chinstrap and `r round(gentoo_vs_adelie_mm)` mm longer than Adelie penguins.

**Limitation.** These are `r n_penguins` penguins measured on `r n_islands` islands near Palmer Station, Antarctica, in `r first_year`–`r last_year`; `r n_no_flipper` have no flipper measurement.

**Data source.** Horst, A. M., Hill, A. P., & Gorman, K. B. (2020). *palmerpenguins: Palmer Archipelago (Antarctica) penguin data* (R package). <https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/> License: CC0.
